verses.original: וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא אוֹדְךָ֣ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י אָנַ֖פְתָּ בִּ֑י יָשֹׁ֥ב אַפְּךָ֖ וּֽתְנַחֲמֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā bay·yō·wm ha·hū ’ō·wḏ·ḵā Yah·weh kî ’ā·nap̄·tā bî yā·šōḇ ’ap·pə·ḵā ū·ṯə·na·ḥă·mê·nî
verses.literal: In that day you will say O LORD I will praise You Although You were angry with me Your anger has turned away and You have comforted me

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה אֵ֧ל יְשׁוּעָתִ֛י אֶבְטַ֖ח וְלֹ֣א אֶפְחָ֑ד כִּֽי־ עָזִּ֤י וְזִמְרָת֙ יָ֣הּ יְהוָ֔ה וַֽיְהִי־ לִ֖י לִֽישׁוּעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ’êl yə·šū·‘ā·ṯî ’eḇ·ṭaḥ wə·lō ’ep̄·ḥāḏ kî- ‘āz·zî wə·zim·rāṯ yāh Yah·weh way·hî- lî lî·šū·‘āh
verses.literal: Surely God is my salvation I will trust and not be afraid For the LORD GOD is my strength and my song and He also has become my salvation
With joy you will draw water from the springs of salvation

verses.original: וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֞ם בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא הוֹד֤וּ לַֽיהוָה֙ קִרְא֣וּ בִשְׁמ֔וֹ הוֹדִ֥יעוּ בָֽעַמִּ֖ים עֲלִֽילֹתָ֑יו הַזְכִּ֕ירוּ כִּ֥י נִשְׂגָּ֖ב שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·mar·tem bay·yō·wm ha·hū hō·w·ḏū Yah·weh qir·’ū ḇiš·mōw hō·w·ḏî·‘ū ḇā·‘am·mîm ‘ă·lî·lō·ṯāw haz·kî·rū kî niś·gāḇ šə·mōw
verses.literal: and on that day you will say Give praise to the LORD proclaim His name Make His works known among the peoples declare that His name is exalted

verses.original: זַמְּר֣וּ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י גֵא֖וּת עָשָׂ֑ה מְיֻדַּעַת זֹ֖את בְּכָל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: zam·mə·rū Yah·weh kî ḡê·’ūṯ ‘ā·śāh mə·yud·da·ʿaṯ zōṯ bə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Sing to the LORD for He has done glorious things Let this be known in all the earth

verses.original: צַהֲלִ֥י וָרֹ֖נִּי יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת צִיּ֑וֹן כִּֽי־ גָד֥וֹל בְּקִרְבֵּ֖ךְ קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: ṣa·hă·lî wā·rōn·nî yō·wō·še·ḇeṯ ṣî·yō·wn kî- ḡā·ḏō·wl bə·qir·bêḵ qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Cry out and sing O citizen of Zion for great among you is the Holy One of Israel
